name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: Nefarian's severed head is bound for Stormwind Keep after his defeat in Blackwing Lair. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon receives the trophy, a sign that the master of Blackrock Mountain has fallen. The victory is among the Alliance's greatest military triumphs in recent history.

sections.title: A Monument to Victory
sections.body: Nefarian, brood-master of the Black Dragonflight and ruler of Upper Blackrock Spire, has long threatened the surrounding human kingdoms. His defeat ends his twisted experiments and schemes. Carrying his battle-scarred head back to Stormwind gives proof that the Lord of Blackrock has fallen to the Alliance's greatest heroes.

sections.title: Audience at Stormwind Keep
sections.body: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs the kingdom from the throne room of Stormwind Keep. The dragon's severed head shocks the royal court and commands reverence. With the kingdom strained by internal political strife and threats from beyond, the victory lifts morale and earns a place in Alliance history.

faq.q: What is the Lord of Blackrock quest about?
faq.answer: You claim Nefarian's severed head in Blackwing Lair and carry the trophy to Stormwind City. There you present it to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon on behalf of the kingdom.

Nefarian is a great black dragon and the son of Deathwing. He rules from Blackwing Lair in Blackrock Mountain, commands the Blackrock orcs, and conducts sinister experiments to create the chromatic dragonflight.
Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is the paladin ruling Stormwind as regent while King Varian Wrynn is absent. He holds court in Stormwind Keep's throne room and watches over the young Prince Anduin Wrynn.

faq.q: Why is this trophy brought to Stormwind Keep?
faq.answer: Nefarian's rule in Blackrock Mountain threatens the kingdom of Stormwind and the entire southern continent. Bringing his head to the kingdom's military leadership confirms the dragon's defeat and gives the realm a victory to rally around.

faq.q: What happens after giving the head to Bolvar?
faq.answer: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is astounded and declares the triumph will be recorded in history. The next stage of the event has the head mounted publicly for all Stormwind to see.

faq.q: Does turning in this head affect the whole city?
faq.answer: Yes. Nefarian's head is delivered to the capital and raised above the city gates, announcing the dragon's death to citizens and soldiers and strengthening Stormwind's defenders with resolve.

angles.text: For the Alliance, presenting Nefarian's head is a crowning military achievement. It crushes the dragonflight's schemes against human lands.
As a human, you know Blackrock Mountain has sent countless incursions and plots against Stormwind. Its master's defeat brings the realm long-sought retribution and relief.
